description.narrative: Over the last three years, Caritas Kenema in partnership with CAFOD, undertook the implementation of a “Disaster Risk Reduction” (DRR) programme in the Kenema diocese which has not been devoid of challenges in the areas of institutional capacity. Given this experience, and the fact that Caritas Kenema in partnership with CAFOD, will be undertaking the implementation of an "anticipated" EC multi-year grant project titled "Strengthening livelihoods and food security through the development of poultry and fresh water fish farming in Sierra Leone using innovative approaches” with all its very strict requirements for sound performance and good results, it is imperative that solid systems and structures are put in place both at the office and the community levels, that will ensure proper implementation by way of efficient and professional service delivery to target communities, ensuring the active participation of communities at all levels. Apart from these requirements, Caritas Kenema office building itself has not undergone any meaningful renovation for the past few years. The furniture, electrical system, water supply system, toilet facilities and other facilities such as vehicles and computers are all faulty and need urgent rehabilitation. Also, Experience indicates that well structured sensitization of target communities with a view to providing knowledge, skills and understanding of a project before, during and after implementation promotes participation and ownership. In view of this, Caritas Kenema needs a bridging grant to help improve on both its infrastructural and logistical needs, in other to depeen the understanding of communites on the anticipated “ EC funded livelihoods” programme. This grant is aimed at addressing the afore - mentioned issues.
